text: 下面进入小作文 05 · 告示 Notice：科研项目助理招募（对齐 2023 英一规范），英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 招募目的】记住 Notice 禁写 Dear！首行写 Notice 加日期后，直接用物称开头阐明招募目的：
This notice is issued for the purpose of recruiting a diligent student assistant for Professor Smith's research project on campus sports activities.
手术刀点拨：This notice is issued for the purpose of 是招募类告示万能第一句；本题题干明确写 use 'Li Ming' instead，故落款必须写 Li Ming。
【二段 · 职责+条件】用 In the first place 写职责，再用物称 Applicants are expected to 写条件，不要用 You must：

In the first place, the selected assistant will be responsible for collecting survey data. In the second place, applicants are expected to possess strong teamwork spirit and basic data analysis skills.
手术刀点拨：2023 真题明确考 duties 和 requirements，分段两句话干净核销，绝不遗漏。
【价值拔高 + 投递】用 Not only can 突出这份助理工作的收获，并公布投递邮箱：
Not only can this position enrich your research experience, but it also offers a valuable chance to work closely with a distinguished scholar. Those interested should send a resume before January 5.
手术刀点拨：Those interested should send... before [Date] 是 Notice 第三段闭眼照抄句式。
